name: mc_diff
title: Compare a region
description:
Compares a live box with a reference and reports exactly which cells differ: counts by class (missing, unexpected, wrong-material, wrong-properties), "expected -> found" transitions, the bounding box of the differences and the first sample cells in y,z,x order. Optional anomaly checks find floating or stacked snow/carpets/plates/rails/torches/plants, unsupported attached blocks and enclosed air pockets. States compare in canonical form: no minecraft: prefix and no default-valued properties, so light[level=11,waterlogged=false] equals light[level=11]; air, cave_air and void_air are equal. When cells differ, returns a diffId receipt for mc_repair.

WHEN TO USE: to check a finished build or edit against what it should be in one call instead of several mc_inspect slices; to see what changed since a snapshot; to audit a blueprint placement; to find stray snow, floating decorations or sealed air pockets in an area.

WHEN NOT TO USE: for a plain block inventory (mc_inspect); for appearance (mc_render); for exact checks that must freeze keep/filter eligibility and sign text BEFORE building (mc_verify). Entities, sign text and other NBT are not compared.

PARAMETERS/COORDINATES: X grows east, Z grows south, Y grows up. from/to are inclusive corners in any order; volume is capped by limits.max-diff-volume (default 2,000,000) and read in sub-boxes of at most limits.max-read-volume. against takes exactly one reference: {snapshot:id} (its region must contain the box), {expected:[[x,y,z,"state"],...]} (at most 50,000 cells), {expectedFile:name} (server file plugins/Ashlar/expected/<name>.json or .json.gz with the same array or {"cells":[...]}), or {blueprint:{id,palette?}, transform?} (compiled like mc_build; frozen eligible final cells). Reference cells outside the box are counted and skipped. scope "box" (default) also compares undeclared cells against baselineSnapshot when given, else skips them; scope "declared" compares declared cells only. ignore: up to 32 globs such as "*_leaves", "snow[layers=1]" or "oak_*[*]"; a cell is skipped when the reference or the live state matches. compare "material" ignores properties. anomalies: any of floating, stacked, unsupported, enclosedAir. samples 1-1000 (default 50). format: summary (default), cells (all samples) or columns (per x,z column counts and y ranges).

SIDE EFFECTS: none on the world. Stores an owner-scoped diff receipt (at most 100,000 differing cells; expires after two hours or on plugin reload/restart).

world.description: World name. Omitted uses the plugin's configured default world.

from.description: Inclusive [x, y, z] corner of the box to compare.

to.description: Inclusive [x, y, z] corner opposite `from`. Order does not matter.

against.description: Exactly one reference: snapshot, expected, expectedFile or blueprint (transform only with blueprint).

snapshot.description: Snapshot id whose region contains the box.

blueprint.description: Saved blueprint selector, as in mc_build.

transform.description: Optional local transform for the blueprint, as in mc_build.

scope.description: "box": undeclared cells compare against baselineSnapshot when given, else are skipped. "declared": declared reference cells only.

baselineSnapshot.description: Snapshot id for undeclared cells (expected/expectedFile/blueprint references with scope box).

anomalies.description: Placement checks on the live box. floating: snow layer, carpet, pressure plate, rail, standing torch, floor lantern or plant without suitable support below. stacked: snow layer on a partial snow layer. unsupported: attached blocks (ladders, wall torches, signs, doors, banners, hanging blocks) without support. enclosedAir: air not connected to the box boundary.

samples.description: Sample cells kept per list (differences and each anomaly kind).

format.description: summary: counts, transitions, bbox and 5 samples. cells: every kept sample. columns: per x,z column difference counts and y ranges.
